title: Gene Families, Gene Duplications and Pseudogenes
method: Visible theory paragraph words excluding figures, tables, captions, practice, references and UI. Article count includes headings, captions, tables, questions, references; excludes SVG and zoom controls.
comparator: 2.C.03: 7564 narrative words, 17 sections; 2.B.10: 9074 narrative words, 21 sections. This chapter has 15 substantive theory sections within the narrower family organization scope. Two editorial passes assessed mechanism, evidence and practice, not a fixed word quota.
scientific_checks: Verified merged and separate official CSIR Unit 2.C; archived MP SET 2024 text; Alberts and Cooper, Birchler and Yang, Storz, NCBI globin reference, rDNA and histone reviews, GENCODE and GULOP. Reviewed ancestry and locus distinctions, unequal exchange, RNA-derived copies, functional fates, globin gene order and chain stoichiometry, rDNA output, histone variation, pseudogene types and experimental evidence. Revised attribution and added original experimental explanations; recalculated model answers.
limitations: Static source and arithmetic checks only; no interactive browser/device or independent rendered SVG/accessibility audit. Current official MPPSC-hosted SET document not retrieved; archived scan used. Pages deployment pending.
